title: Mirroring Open Zaak status changes gives a municipality a case history independent of its own case system
content:
The integration uses an Open Zaak notification subscription, mirroring each zaak status change as a typed operation. Nothing is modified inside Open Zaak — the subscription is a supported extension point, which matters when the target is public-sector software that a municipality did not write and cannot fork lightly.

The value stated is independence: an independent case history for municipal audit. A case system that holds both the case and the only record of how the case was handled cannot be audited against itself. Mirroring the status transitions produces a record whose survival does not depend on the retention, migration or replacement of the case system.

Two Dutch leads carry this demo — Dimpact at "1 · parallel track", with PodiumD, KISS and Open Zaak in its source row, and the Foundation for Public Code at "3 · later", recorded as a steward of Open Zaak among others. The near-identical demo text also appears attached to a third lead as a separate group, so this finding is split across two notes purely because the two texts differ by a word.
